close_reason: P3 optimization, not prioritized now; easy to add short-circuit in filter_properties later
description: email.rs: filter_properties(&val, &effective_props) is called for every email even when properties=None (meaning return all default properties). In that case the function clones ALL values. At scale (100+ emails per request), this doubles the JSON allocation for the common case. When \!header_props.is_empty() is false and no filtering is needed, filter_properties could be replaced with val.clone() to skip the per-key iteration, or the header-injection branch could restructure to avoid the double-clone.
title: handle_email_get: filter_properties clones all values even when properties=None
